title: MoonWalk RD
description: A veryyy simple low gravity mod I made for RD-132211. Simply press G to change your gravity!
body:
# MoonWalk RD (rd-132211)

A simple physics tweak for the earliest version of Minecraft. This mod allows you to explore the simple RubyDung map with low gravity!

### 🚀 Features
* **Toggle Gravity:** Switch between normal gravity and low gravity.
* **Jump Highter** Jump higher than normal in this version.
* **Floaty Movement:** Fall slower and stay in the air longer.

### ⌨️ Controls
* **Press [ G ]**: Toggle Low Gravity mode.

---

### 📦 How to Install (Prism Launcher)
1. **Right-click** your `rd-132211` instance and select **Edit**.
2. Click the **Version** tab on the left.
3. Click the **Add to Minecraft.jar** button on the right.
4. Select the **MoonWalk_RD.zip** file you downloaded.
5. Launch the game and start jumping!
